build_mrope_embedding: build a multimodal rotary embedding module with text, height, and width sections for Qwen2-VL models
run_triton_mrope_kernel: run a triton kernel that applies multimodal rotary position embeddings to query and key tensors
apply_interleaved_rope: apply interleaved MRoPE to reorganize 3D rotary embeddings from chunked to interleaved frequency layout
test_forward_cuda_mrope: test the forward_cuda method that applies triton-accelerated multimodal rotary embeddings on CUDA
summarize_get_next_input_positions: summarize the static method that generates next input positions for text, height, and width modalities
